about_the_game:
🏆 Ball & Roll – Roll, Race, Reach the Top!

Ball & Roll is a physics-based platformer that tests your reflexes and speed. Play solo or with up to 4 players in multiplayer mode, overcome challenging obstacles, and race to the top in the fastest time possible. But be careful! One mistake could send you all the way back to the start!

⚡ Fast-Paced, Competitive Gameplay Perfect for Speedrunning!

Ball & Roll is designed for speedrunning—every second counts! Time your movements precisely, control your speed, and skillfully navigate obstacles to reach the top as fast as possible.

👥 Solo or Multiplayer with up to 4 Players!

Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete with friends in chaotic, high-speed multiplayer races! With up to 4-player multiplayer, the competition is intense and fun!

⚠️ Tough Obstacles & High Stakes!

In Ball & Roll, one wrong move can ruin everything!

  • Dangerous platforms and gaps

  • Jump pads, speed ramps, and narrow paths

  • Various traps waiting to knock you down

  • Fall, and you start from the beginning!

To avoid falling back, maintain balance, time your jumps carefully, and roll past obstacles with precision!

🎨 Fun Visuals & Dynamic Physics!

Ball & Roll features stylized, charming graphics in a colorful and fun world. Thanks to physics-based mechanics, every roll feels dynamic and unpredictable!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-750
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce 650TI | AMD R7 250x
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Ball & Roll is a physics-based platform game that you can play solo or with friends! Control your cute animal inside a rolling ball, overcome challenging obstacles, move fast, and reach the top as quickly as possible. But be careful... One mistake can send you all the way back to the start!
